# Reviewed exceptions to the history gate (tools/check-history-surface.mjs).
#
# The gate reads every commit the mirror is about to publish: the lines it
# adds, the paths it writes and its message. A finding on a commit that is not
# merged yet is fixed by rewriting the branch (rebase, amend or reword). A
# finding on a commit already merged into dev or main cannot be rewritten, so
# the mirror stays blocked until someone decides the finding may go public and
# pins it here, one line per finding, exactly as the gate printed it:
#
#   <full commit sha> <rule> <file, or :message>   # why it may go public
#
# A pin PUBLISHES the content it names. This file is world-readable: a pin
# names a commit, a rule and a path, never the content. Add pins only on a PR
# a maintainer reviews, and only after a secret in the pinned commit has been
# rotated (pinning does not make a leaked secret safe).
